nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the main focus of the special issue titled "Challenges and Recent Advancements in Nuclear Energy Systems"?
nodes.answer: The special issue focuses on studies, insights, and innovations related to the growth of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes, particularly in the context of Saudi Arabia’s nuclear initiatives and aspirations.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy storage technologies|Advances in energy storage technologies_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why is interest in renewable energy storage devices increasing?
nodes.answer: Interest is increasing due to the dependence on non-renewable fossil fuels and the need for environmentally friendly, high-performance energy storage solutions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy storage technologies|Advances in energy storage technologies_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How did the researchers improve the power factor of the Fe-V-Al alloy?
nodes.answer: By implementing the off-stoichiometric concept, the power factor of the Fe-V-Al alloy was further improved to 68 x 10^(-4) W/m K².
